facts.fact: Cameroon's national climate change observatory ONACC launched on 2026-01-14 a climate-risk monitoring platform for drought and flood early warning, built on weather observation, satellite imagery and field data, which it says serves agriculture among other sectors.
facts.system: ONACC plateforme numérique de suivi des risques climatiques
